definitions.explanation: Waste that can be incinerated, such as food scraps, paper, and certain plastics. One of the main garbage categories in Japanese waste separation.

examples.japanese: {可燃|かねん}ごみは{火曜日|かようび}です。
{生|なま}ゴミは{可燃|かねん}ごみに{出|だ}す。
examples.english: Put food waste in burnable garbage.

examples.japanese: {可燃|かねん}ごみは{指定|してい}の{袋|ふくろ}に{入|い}れて{出|だ}してください。
examples.english: Please put burnable garbage in the designated bags.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {可燃|かねん}ごみを{出|だ}す: to put out burnable garbage
- {可燃|かねん}ごみの{日|ひ}: burnable garbage day
- {指定|してい}{袋|ぶくろ}: designated garbage bag

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan has strict garbage separation rules that vary by municipality. Burnable garbage typically includes kitchen waste, paper, and some plastics.

RELATED:
- {不燃|ふねん}ごみ: non-burnable garbage
- {資源|しげん}ごみ: recyclable waste
- {粗大|そだい}ごみ: oversized garbage
